source: Fueli recipe library, written for this app (Oct 2026). Every ingredient is priced by the nutrition database or is a pantry staple. Quantities are for one serving. "optional" ingredients are used only when they are in the fridge and fit the diet; "anyOf" lists interchangeable ingredients (the first one in the fridge that fits the diet is used); "flex" marks the use-it-up recipes; {0} and {1} in a name are filled with the chosen anyOf labels.

recipes.name: Banana peanut butter oats
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes, stirring.
Slice the banana on top and add the peanut butter.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt berry bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with the berries and oats, then drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Spinach and mushroom omelette
steps: Slice the mushrooms and cook them in the oil for 3 minutes, then add the spinach until wilted.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt, pour over the vegetables and cook on low heat.
Sprinkle the cheese, fold and serve.

recipes.name: Avocado toast with eggs
steps: Toast the bread and fry or poach the eggs.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper, spread on the toast and top with the eggs.

recipes.name: Tofu scramble on toast
steps: Soften the chopped onion in the oil.
Crumble in the tofu, add the diced tomato and soy sauce and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and serve on toast.

recipes.name: Egg and bean breakfast burrito
steps: Cook the diced pepper for 3 minutes, add the beans to warm through.
Scramble in the eggs.
Fill the warm tortilla, add the cheese and roll.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese with apple and walnuts
steps: Dice the apple.
Top the cottage cheese with apple and walnuts and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Sweet potato hash with eggs
steps: Dice the sweet potato and fry in the oil for 12 minutes.
Add the onion and pepper and cook 5 minutes more.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread the peanut butter and top with sliced banana.

recipes.name: Overnight oats with blueberries
steps: Stir the oats into the soy milk and leave in the fridge overnight (or 10 minutes for a quick version).
Top with blueberries and chopped almonds.

recipes.name: Strawberry banana smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

recipes.name: Blueberry peanut butter smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

recipes.name: Bacon, eggs and grilled tomato
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp, then fry the eggs in the same pan.
Grill the halved tomato for 3 minutes and serve with toast.

recipes.name: Apple cinnamon quinoa porridge
steps: Warm the cooked quinoa in the almond milk for 5 minutes.
Stir in the grated apple and cinnamon and top with walnuts.

recipes.name: Hummus and cucumber toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread the hummus.
Top with sliced cucumber and tomato.

recipes.name: Garlic chicken rice bowl
steps: Slice the chicken and cook in the oil with the garlic for 7 minutes.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Serve over warm rice with the soy sauce.

recipes.name: Tuna salad wrap
steps: Mix the tuna with the yogurt.
Fill the tortilla with lettuce, tomato, cucumber and the tuna, then roll.

recipes.name: Chickpea quinoa salad
steps: Dice the cucumber and tomato.
Toss with the quinoa and chickpeas, lemon juice and oil.

recipes.name: Tomato lentil soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato, lentils and water and simmer 20 minutes.
Season and blend half if you like it thick.

recipes.name: Black bean burrito bowl
steps: Warm the rice, beans and corn.
Top with diced pepper and avocado and squeeze over the lemon.

recipes.name: Tomato mozzarella pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Toss with the chopped tomato, spinach and oil while hot, then add the torn mozzarella.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with peas
steps: Fry the diced carrot and peas in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and fry 3 minutes, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Mix together with the soy sauce.

recipes.name: Salmon and avocado spinach salad
steps: Pan-fry the salmon 4 minutes each side.
Toss the spinach, cucumber and avocado with lemon and oil, then flake the salmon on top.

recipes.name: Tofu and broccoli stir fry
steps: Cube the tofu and fry until golden.
Add the broccoli, pepper and garlic and stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Hummus veggie wrap
steps: Spread the hummus on the tortilla.
Add the spinach, grated carrot and cucumber and roll.

recipes.name: Chicken quesadilla
steps: Cook the sliced chicken, pepper and onion for 7 minutes.
Fill the tortillas with the mix and cheese and toast 2 minutes per side.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli with rice
steps: Slice the beef thinly and sear in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the broccoli and garlic and cook 4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chicken salad sandwich
steps: Chop the cooked chicken and apple and mix with the yogurt.
Fill the bread with lettuce and the chicken salad.

recipes.name: Tempeh kale grain bowl
steps: Slice and pan-fry the tempeh until golden, add the soy sauce.
Massage the kale, grate the carrot and serve everything over the quinoa.

recipes.name: Potato and egg salad
steps: Boil the cubed potatoes 12 minutes and the eggs 9 minutes.
Cool, chop and mix with the yogurt, cucumber and onion.

recipes.name: Baked salmon with sweet potato and broccoli
steps: Roast the sweet potato wedges at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Add the salmon and broccoli for the last 12 minutes and finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Chicken vegetable stir fry
steps: Stir-fry the sliced chicken 6 minutes.
Add the pepper, zucchini and garlic for 4 minutes, then the soy sauce.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over the cooked pasta.

recipes.name: Chickpea spinach curry
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, stir in the curry spice.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Garlic shrimp pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the garlic in the oil, add the shrimp for 3 minutes, then the spinach.
Toss with the pasta and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Pork loin with roast potatoes and carrots
steps: Roast the cubed potatoes and carrots at 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Sear the pork 4 minutes per side and rest before slicing.

recipes.name: Vegetable frittata
steps: Soften the vegetables in the oil for 5 minutes.
Pour over the beaten eggs and parmesan and cook on low, covered, for 8 minutes.

recipes.name: Lentil bolognese
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and garlic.
Add the tomatoes and lentils and simmer 12 minutes.
Serve over the cooked pasta.

recipes.name: Chicken thigh traybake
steps: Toss everything with the oil and a pinch of salt.
Roast at 200 °C for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Peanut tofu noodles
steps: Cook the noodles and pan-fry the cubed tofu.
Whisk the peanut butter and soy sauce with a splash of hot water.
Toss everything with the grated carrot and cucumber.

recipes.name: Steak with potato and broccoli
steps: Boil the potato 15 minutes and steam the broccoli 4 minutes.
Sear the steak 3 to 4 minutes per side and rest.
Serve with the butter on the potato.

recipes.name: Black bean tacos
steps: Warm the beans and corn.
Fill the tortillas with beans, corn, tomato, avocado and cheese.

recipes.name: Creamy mushroom spinach rice
steps: Cook the onion and sliced mushrooms in the butter for 6 minutes.
Stir in the rice and a splash of water, then the spinach and parmesan.

recipes.name: Tuna pasta bake
steps: Mix the cooked pasta, tuna, peas and chopped tomato in a dish.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Quinoa stuffed peppers
steps: Halve and seed the peppers.
Mix the quinoa, beans, corn, tomato and onion and fill the peppers.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Cheesy scrambled egg toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Scramble the eggs on low heat, stir in the cheese at the end and pile onto the toast.

recipes.name: Easy shakshuka
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil, add the chopped tomatoes and paprika and simmer 8 minutes.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5 minutes.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Orange yogurt parfait
steps: Segment the orange.
Layer the yogurt, oats and orange and top with chopped almonds.

recipes.name: Savory oats with egg and spinach
steps: Simmer the oats in the water for 5 minutes and stir in the spinach.
Top with a fried or soft-boiled egg and a dash of soy sauce.

recipes.name: Kale and mushroom scramble
steps: Cook the kale and sliced mushrooms in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the beaten eggs and scramble gently.

recipes.name: Banana oat pancakes
steps: Blend the banana, eggs and oats into a batter.
Cook small pancakes in a sprayed pan, 2 minutes per side, and top with blueberries.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese and tomato toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread the cottage cheese, top with sliced tomato and black pepper.

recipes.name: Egg breakfast quesadilla
steps: Scramble the eggs with the spinach.
Fill half the tortilla with eggs and cheese, fold and toast 2 minutes per side.

recipes.name: Potato and egg skillet
steps: Dice the potato and fry in the oil for 15 minutes, adding the onion halfway.
Crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set.

recipes.name: Tofu breakfast wrap
steps: Crumble the tofu into a pan with the soy sauce and cook 5 minutes.
Add the spinach and tomato, then fill the warm tortilla and roll.

recipes.name: Smashed chickpea avocado toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the chickpeas and avocado with lemon and salt and spread on top.

recipes.name: Apple peanut butter oats
steps: Simmer the oats in the almond milk for 5 minutes.
Top with the diced apple and peanut butter.

recipes.name: Double berry smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

recipes.name: Green banana smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

recipes.name: Salmon and egg toast
steps: Pan-fry the salmon 3 minutes each side and flake it.
Scramble the eggs and serve on toast with the salmon and avocado.

recipes.name: Yogurt with banana and walnuts
steps: Slice the banana over the yogurt.
Top with walnuts and honey.

recipes.name: Corn and pepper omelette
steps: Cook the diced pepper and corn in the oil for 3 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs, cook on low, add the cheese and fold.

recipes.name: Sweet potato toast with peanut butter
steps: Slice the sweet potato lengthwise 1 cm thick and toast 2 to 3 rounds until tender.
Top with peanut butter and banana slices.

recipes.name: Bacon avocado toast
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread, spread the avocado and top with bacon and tomato.

recipes.name: Orange almond quinoa bowl
steps: Warm the quinoa in the soy milk.
Top with orange segments and chopped almonds.

recipes.name: Tuna rice bowl
steps: Warm the rice.
Top with tuna, sliced cucumber and avocado and drizzle with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken caesar salad
steps: Pan-fry the chicken 6 minutes per side and slice.
Whisk the yogurt with lemon and half the parmesan for the dressing; toast and cube the bread.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, chicken, croutons and remaining parmesan.

recipes.name: Lentil tomato salad
steps: Dice the vegetables.
Toss with the lentils, lemon juice and oil.

recipes.name: Shrimp fried rice
steps: Cook the shrimp in the oil for 3 minutes and set aside.
Fry the rice and peas 3 minutes, scramble in the egg, return the shrimp and add the soy sauce.

recipes.name: Bean and cheese quesadilla
steps: Mash the beans lightly.
Fill the tortillas with beans, vegetables and cheese and toast 2 minutes per side.

recipes.name: Chicken pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta and chicken; slice the chicken.
Toss everything with the oil and parmesan.

recipes.name: Egg salad sandwich
steps: Boil the eggs 9 minutes, cool and chop.
Mix with the yogurt and fill the bread with lettuce.

recipes.name: Peanut tofu rice bowl
steps: Pan-fry the cubed tofu until golden.
Whisk the peanut butter and soy sauce with a splash of hot water.
Serve the tofu and vegetables over rice with the sauce.

recipes.name: Beef burrito bowl
steps: Brown the beef with the spice.
Warm the rice and beans and serve topped with beef, tomato, corn and lettuce.

recipes.name: Mushroom cheese toast
steps: Cook the sliced mushrooms and garlic in the butter for 5 minutes.
Pile onto the bread, top with mozzarella and grill until melted.

recipes.name: Sweet potato black bean bowl
steps: Cube the sweet potato and roast or microwave until tender, about 10 to 20 minutes.
Serve with the warm beans, kale and avocado and squeeze over the lemon.

recipes.name: Chicken hummus wrap
steps: Cook and slice the chicken.
Spread the hummus on the tortilla, add the chicken and vegetables and roll.

recipes.name: Chickpea minestrone
steps: Soften the onion and carrot, add the zucchini, tomato, herbs and water and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and cooked pasta and heat through.

recipes.name: Salmon rice bowl
steps: Pan-fry the salmon 4 minutes per side and flake.
Serve over rice with cucumber, avocado and soy sauce.

recipes.name: Tomato mozzarella sandwich
steps: Layer the mozzarella, tomato and spinach between the bread.
Toast in a pan if you like it warm.

recipes.name: Tuna quinoa salad
steps: Toss everything together and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Lemon pea pasta
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Toss with butter, parmesan and lemon.

recipes.name: Chickpea hummus wrap
steps: Lightly mash the chickpeas.
Spread the hummus on the tortilla, add the chickpeas and vegetables and roll.

recipes.name: Tuna baked potato
steps: Microwave the pricked potato 8 to 10 minutes until soft.
Mix the tuna, yogurt and corn and spoon into the split potato.

recipes.name: Kale chicken salad
steps: Cook and slice the chicken.
Massage the kale with the oil and lemon, then toss with the apple, walnuts and chicken.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon with rice
steps: Pan-fry the salmon 4 minutes per side.
Add the soy sauce and honey to the pan and spoon the glaze over.
Serve with rice and steamed broccoli.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
steps: Slice the chicken, pepper and onion and stir-fry with the spice for 8 minutes.
Serve in warm tortillas with avocado.

recipes.name: Beef tacos
steps: Brown the beef with the spice.
Fill the tortillas with beef, tomato, lettuce and cheese.

recipes.name: Shrimp and broccoli stir fry
steps: Stir-fry the broccoli, pepper and garlic 4 minutes.
Add the shrimp for 3 minutes, then the soy sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Tofu tomato curry
steps: Soften the onion, add the curry spice and tomato and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the cubed tofu and spinach for 5 minutes and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Lemon chicken with quinoa
steps: Pan-fry the chicken 6 minutes per side with the zucchini.
Squeeze over the lemon and serve on the quinoa.

recipes.name: Pork noodle stir fry
steps: Slice the pork thinly and stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables for 3 minutes, then the cooked noodles and soy sauce.

recipes.name: Garlic mushroom pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Fry the sliced mushrooms and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes, add the spinach.
Toss with the pasta and parmesan.

recipes.name: One-pan chicken thigh and rice
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil 5 minutes per side.
Add the onion, peas and rice with a splash of water, cover and cook 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Salmon with potatoes and kale
steps: Boil the cubed potato 12 minutes.
Pan-fry the salmon 4 minutes per side and wilt the kale in the same pan.
Finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Black bean chili with rice
steps: Soften the onion and pepper, add the spice, tomatoes and beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the corn and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Garlic beef rice bowl
steps: Brown the beef with the garlic, add the soy sauce and spinach.
Serve over rice with a fried egg on top.

recipes.name: Zucchini lemon pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the grated zucchini and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes.
Toss with the pasta, lemon and parmesan.

recipes.name: Tempeh broccoli stir fry
steps: Fry the sliced tempeh until golden.
Add the broccoli and carrot for 4 minutes, then the soy sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken and sweet potato traybake
steps: Toss the cubed sweet potato with the oil and roast at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and broccoli and roast 18 minutes more.

recipes.name: Shrimp tacos
steps: Cook the shrimp with the spice for 3 minutes.
Fill the tortillas with lettuce, shrimp and avocado and squeeze over the lemon.

recipes.name: Lentil sweet potato curry
steps: Soften the onion with the spice, add the diced sweet potato and tomato and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the lentils and spinach and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pork with apple and potatoes
steps: Roast the cubed potato and onion at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Add the pork and apple wedges and roast 18 minutes more.

recipes.name: Cheesy broccoli pasta
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 4 minutes.
Melt the cheese into the milk and butter and toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Cheesy tuna rice bake
steps: Mix the rice, tuna, peas and milk in a dish.
Top with cheese and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Use-it-up {0} veggie scramble
steps: Chop whatever vegetables you have and cook them in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the beaten eggs or crumbled tofu and cook until set; finish with cheese if you have it.

recipes.name: Use-it-up loaded {0}
steps: Toast the bread or warm the wrap.
Add your spread or eggs and pile on whatever fruit or vegetables you have.

recipes.name: Use-it-up {0} fruit bowl
steps: Use the oats or quinoa with warm milk, or the yogurt or cottage cheese as it is.
Top with whatever fruit and nuts you have.

recipes.name: Use-it-up {1} fried {0}
steps: Cook the protein in the oil (eggs last), then the chopped vegetables for 4 minutes.
Add the cooked grain and fry 3 minutes; season with soy sauce or salt.

recipes.name: Use-it-up {1} {0}
steps: Cook the protein if it needs it.
Fill the wrap or bread with the protein, a spread and whatever salad you have.

recipes.name: Use-it-up {1} salad
steps: Cook the protein if it needs it.
Toss the greens with the vegetables, oil and lemon, then add the protein.

recipes.name: Use-it-up {1} veggie {0}
steps: Cook the grain or pasta.
Cook the protein, then sauté the garlic and vegetables in the oil for 6 minutes.
Toss everything together, with parmesan if you have it.

recipes.name: Use-it-up {0} curry
steps: Soften the onion and any hard vegetables in the oil with the curry spice.
Add the protein, the other vegetables and a splash of water and simmer 12 minutes.
Serve with the grain.

recipes.name: Use-it-up {0} traybake
steps: Cut everything into similar pieces and toss with the oil and herbs.
Roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes (eggs: crack them in for the last 8 minutes); cook a grain separately if you used one.

recipes.name: Use-it-up {0} vegetable soup
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and harder vegetables for 5 minutes.
Add the water, protein and the rest of the vegetables and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta or rice to cook, or serve with bread.
